field.label: Block REST Payment Routes
field.comment: Answer 404 on the REST routes that set a payment or place an order (guest-carts and carts/mine: payment-information, set-payment-information, selected-payment-method, order). Enable when the storefront checkout places orders without these routes, for example Hyva Checkout. Card-testing bots use them to skip the checkout form and its reCAPTCHA.

field.label: Failed Payment Attempts per Cart
field.comment: Deactivate a cart after this many failed payment attempts, on every order path (storefront, REST, GraphQL). 0 disables the limit. Each failure and each deactivation is written to var/log/checkout_guard.log.
